commit.message:
feat: return to dock staging pose on failure (#6403)

* feat: return to dock staging pose on failure

* if all docking retries have failed, then return to the dock staging
  pose before reporting failure
* swallow any new exceptions that may occur, in order to report the
  original docking failure reason

Fixes #6399

Signed-off-by: Nikolaos Drosinos <nikolaos.drosinos@ocado.com>

* fixup: address review comments

* return to staging pose in case of docking failure only if a positive
  value has been specified for docking_server.max_retries parameter
* don't handle resetApproach() failure (i.e., cancelled, preempted, or
  shutting down); just fallthrough and let the general case handle it

* Update nav2_docking/opennav_docking/src/docking_server.cpp

Signed-off-by: Steve Macenski <stevenmacenski@gmail.com>

commit.message:
Fix pose topic subscription leak when following ends via static object timeout (#6384)

The follow_object action releases its dynamic pose topic subscription on
every terminal exit path except one: when the action succeeds because the
object has been static for longer than static_object_timeout. In that case
the subscription stays alive while the server is idle, receiving messages
until the next goal starts or the node shuts down.

Also release the subscription in on_cleanup() for consistency with the
other managed resources there.

Add a unit test that drives the action through the static object timeout
success path and asserts the subscriber count for the topic drops back
to zero once the action has succeeded.

Signed-off-by: lawliet <lawliet206@163.com>

commit.message:
Guard getPoseAtDistance against undefined projection at zero distance (#6385)

* Guard getPoseAtDistance against undefined projection at zero distance

When the robot pose coincides with the tracked object pose,
std::hypot(dx, dy) evaluates to exactly 0 and the backwards projection
divides by it, producing NaN coordinates that would propagate into the
control command. Return the tracked pose unchanged in that case and add
a unit test covering the scenario.

Signed-off-by: lawliet <lawliet206@163.com>

* Apply review feedback: use 1e-6 epsilon threshold, drop comment and log

Signed-off-by: lawliet <lawliet206@163.com>

Signed-off-by: lawliet <lawliet206@163.com>

commit.message:
Make follow_object reinit-lock handling exception-safe (#6386)

* Make follow_object reinit-lock handling exception-safe

followObject() holds the parameter-handler reinit mutex through a
std::lock_guard for the whole action, but temporarily released it around
create_subscription() with raw mutex_.unlock()/lock() calls. If
create_subscription() throws (e.g. an invalid goal-provided topic name),
the manual re-lock is skipped and the lock_guard destructor then unlocks
a mutex this thread no longer owns, which is undefined behavior.

Switch to std::unique_lock and use its ownership-aware unlock()/lock()
so every exit path stays correct. No behavior change in the normal path.

Signed-off-by: lawliet <lawliet206@163.com>

* Remove unneeded comments in followObject

Signed-off-by: lawliet <lawliet206@163.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: lawliet <lawliet206@163.com>
